provenance: Read off Wu et al. 2024's GSM8K inference-scaling figure (weighted majority voting, Pythia family) by eye — APPROXIMATE digitization, tolerance roughly +/-3 accuracy points and ~1.5x on FLOPs. x = inference FLOPs per question in units of 1e11; y = accuracy %, replotted as 100 minus the figure's test-error axis. Series order in `points`, with lengths in fit.params: Pythia-410M (6 points), Pythia-2.8B (6), Pythia-12B (5); the paper's 1.4B and 6.9B series are omitted for chart legibility, which does not change the finding. The finding preserved by the digitization: at small compute budgets, drawing more samples from a smaller model is the compute-optimal choice; each model's curve then flattens (saturates), and at large budgets the bigger model pulls ahead.
